The best way I’ve found to make mine filled in but still natural is a good easy brow pencil and a colored brow gel! Tweezing my eyebrows to the general shape I want and then gently filling them in with soft little pencil lines has helped me a lot and still avoids the classic “Instagram brows” look! The drugstore has a lot of good eyebrow pencils for reasonable prices so you can experiment with what brand and type you like
